mapper.select: SELECT r.id, s.id AS id_site, AS site_name, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 'UTC', IFNULL(r.offset_timezone, 'UTC')), '%m/%d/%Y') AS report_date, s.ac_capacity, s.dc_capacity, s.data_send_time, r.subscribers, r.data_intervals, r.type_report, r.type_option, r.cadence_range, #{start_date} AS start_date, #{end_date} AS end_date FROM report r LEFT JOIN site_employee_map sem ON sem.id_employee = r.id_employee LEFT JOIN site s ON s.id = sem.id_site LEFT JOIN time_zone tz ON tz.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE r.id = #{id} #{item} AND (CONVERT_TZ(NOW(), 'UTC', tz.value) < s.expiration OR s.expiration IS NULL) GROUP BY s.id
